events.title: Root cause: Pricing.cs line 16
events.summary: The tier discount table added in 9bfbf7d omits the existing standard tier, so direct indexing throws KeyNotFoundException for standard customers.
events.why: Names the line the patch must change; the tests will check the claim.
events.detail:
The agent's diagnosis, from the rationale it gave write_proposal:

The tier discount table added in 9bfbf7d omits the existing standard tier, so direct indexing throws KeyNotFoundException for standard customers. Using the dictionary's zero default preserves the established no-discount behavior for standard (and other unlisted) tiers while retaining configured gold and silver discounts.

- **File:** `src/Orders.Api/Pricing.cs:16`

events.title: Patch proposed: 1 line in Pricing.cs
events.summary: proposals/standard-tier-default-discount.patch replaces 1 line with 1; the repo is untouched until someone approves it.
events.detail:
The change, as `write_proposal` wrote it:
- `- var discount = TierDiscounts[customer.Tier];`
- `+ var discount = TierDiscounts.GetValueOrDefault(customer.Tier);`
